enhancements.title: Mode label
enhancements.implementation: Dedicated label and a 2 × 2 phone mode selector.

enhancements.title: Mobile navigation
enhancements.implementation: Collapsible studio navigation; redundant phone sidebar removed.

enhancements.title: Visible modes
enhancements.implementation: All four Euler modes remain visible without horizontal scrolling.

enhancements.title: Compact toolbar
enhancements.implementation: Zoom, fit and reset stay visible; other actions are under More.

enhancements.title: Single scrolling
enhancements.implementation: The outer lab panel scrolls; nested complex studio containers do not.

enhancements.title: Earlier visualization
enhancements.implementation: Compact learning tabs and header; camera presets follow the figure.

enhancements.title: Unobstructed content
enhancements.implementation: Reserved footer space for the smaller assistant and learning button.

enhancements.title: Typeset mathematics
enhancements.implementation: KaTeX equations in the Euler workspace, topic preview and learning panels.

enhancements.title: Control contrast
enhancements.implementation: Readable text controls with explicit selected and disabled states.

enhancements.title: Control grouping
enhancements.implementation: Separate modes, mathematical parameters, camera presets and coaching.

enhancements.title: Degrees and radians
enhancements.implementation: Both units appear together, with exact labels at quarter turns.

enhancements.title: Direct angle entry
enhancements.implementation: Bounded numerical input from 0° to 720°, linked with the slider.

enhancements.title: Angle shortcuts
enhancements.implementation: 0, π/2, π, 3π/2, 2π and 4π shortcuts.

enhancements.title: Playback
enhancements.implementation: Play/pause, 15° steps, speed selection and a 720° stop.

enhancements.title: Helix axes
enhancements.implementation: Colored Re, Im and θ axes, with radians on the angle axis.

enhancements.title: Third dimension explained
enhancements.implementation: Unwrapped angle is distinguished from the complex components.

enhancements.title: Camera presets
enhancements.implementation: 3D, complex plane, cosine and sine projections.

enhancements.title: Interaction guidance
enhancements.implementation: Visible drag/pinch instructions and expanded Help.

enhancements.title: Consistent colors
enhancements.implementation: Blue real, purple imaginary, amber angle, teal exact, pink Taylor.

enhancements.title: Legend
enhancements.implementation: Text and marker shapes distinguish exact and Taylor values.

enhancements.title: Trace length
enhancements.implementation: Quarter-turn to two-turn history control for the circle and helix.

enhancements.title: Angle and radius
enhancements.implementation: Angle arc, unit radius and projected component guides.

enhancements.title: Linked comparison
enhancements.implementation: Optional simultaneous helix, circle and sine/cosine views.

enhancements.title: Taylor error
enhancements.implementation: Live Euclidean error between the partial sum and exact point.

enhancements.title: Taylor terms explained
enhancements.implementation: N counts n = 0 through N−1; the constant term and radians are explicit.

enhancements.title: Guided learning
enhancements.implementation: Five selectable steps, sequential progression and relevant-panel highlighting.

enhancements.title: Prediction
enhancements.implementation: Next-quarter-turn prediction with checking and reveal on the figure.

enhancements.title: Challenge feedback
enhancements.implementation: Separate blank, invalid, incorrect and correct responses with a hint.

enhancements.title: Accessibility
enhancements.implementation: Keyboard controls, focus rings, point descriptions, reduced-motion playback and 3D fallback.

enhancements.title: Complete shared state
enhancements.implementation: Angle, terms, trace, camera position/target, split view, grid, labels, zoom and speed saved in fig URL state.
